meta.illustrative_note: Sample data. Every figure is illustrative and generated to plausible magnitudes for a pitch; none is a verified benchmark or a live result.

reach_model.note: reach(window) = sum(daily reach) x n_days^(-exponent) per channel; multi-channel reach is the sum x an interpolated cross-channel dedup factor (1 channel = 1.0, all = cross_channel_dedup).

splits.note: Shares of impressions (frequency: share of people reached) per channel. The dashboard multiplies them by the impressions / reach in the selected window and channels. Platform-reported, illustrative.
